description: Make a link that opens a sketch in the Mokxi editor, for code with no circuit worked out: Mokxi reads the sketch, picks the board when none is given and places and wires the parts the code names. The sketch is not checked here. Returns the link. In the editor, Upload to board then writes the sketch to a real Arduino AVR or ESP32-C3 board over USB (Chrome or Edge).

board.description: The board to open it on, such as "uno", "esp32" or "pico". Left out, Mokxi picks one from the code.

code.description: The whole sketch, 24 thousand characters at most.

name: create_code_link
title: Make a link from code
